test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (JSO) 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a role of tabulation?

options.text: It gives identity to the data.

solution:
The correct answer is **It provides descriptive statistics.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **It provides descriptive statistics:**

 
 
• Descriptive statistics involve summarizing and organizing data so it can be easily understood. This includes measures like mean, median, mode, and standard deviation.
 
• Tabulation, however, focuses on arranging data into rows and columns, making it easier to read and interpret but does not inherently involve calculating these statistical measures.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **It simplifies complex data:**

 
 
• Tabulation helps in breaking down complex data sets into manageable parts, making it easier to understand and analyze large volumes of information.
 
• For a financial enterprise, this is crucial in presenting financial statements, sales data, or any large dataset in a comprehensible format.
 
 
 
• **It gives identity to the data:**
 
 
• Tabulation assigns a structured format to the data, providing a clear identity to each data point through rows and columns.
 
• This structured representation is essential for tracking financial transactions, customer details, or inventory lists in a financial enterprise.
 
 
 
• **It facilitates comparison:**
 
 
• By organizing data into a tabular form, tabulation allows for easy comparison across different data points.
